form:FormGroup.label: Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The data type of the field, for example Text, Date, Long or DenseVector. The type controls how values are indexed and which query conditions can be used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Data type of the field. Controls how values are indexed and queried.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of the field. Values in the indexing XML are matched to this name, and it is the name used in queries.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Must match the field name in the indexing XML.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the field's value is kept in the index. A stored value can be shown in search results straight from the index; a field that isn't stored has to be extracted from the original data, which is slower.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stored values can be shown without extracting them from the data.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the field can be searched. Only indexed fields can be used in query conditions; an unindexed field can still be stored and shown in results.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Only indexed fields can be used in query conditions.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the position of each term in the value is kept, so a query can match a phrase, with its words together and in order. Without positions, each word of a query value is matched on its own. Makes the index larger.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Needed to match phrases. Makes the index larger.

form:FormGroup.label: Analyser
form:FormGroup.helpText: How the field's text is split into terms for indexing and searching: Keyword (whole value as one term), Alpha, Numeric, Alpha numeric, Whitespace, Stop words or Standard.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: How text is split into searchable terms. Keyword keeps the whole value.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether matching takes account of upper and lower case. When unticked, values are indexed and searched in lower case, so 'Error' matches 'error'.
